tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Call this first to learn what is sold: the plans with their CHF prices and limits, the free trial, the continuous-feed rule, the redistribution terms, and links (signup, API reference, OpenAPI). To price a specific usage, use quote_price_for.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: Every FX pair and spot metal a paid plan carries, with its name and class.

tools.name: quote_price_for
tools.description: Price a month of a usage you already know: simultaneous connections at peak, slices of 1000 bars, and symbols followed live continuously. Answers the smallest plan covering it and the CHF total before VAT. For the plans themselves, use get_offer.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Candle history for one symbol, one page, oldest first, with your API key in the request's Authorization header (Bearer adk_live_... or adk_test_...) or in its X-API-Key header (adk_live_..., for a client or gateway that keeps Authorization for itself; two different keys are refused with CONFLICTING_

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_candles" references sensitive artifacts (api_key, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
